top_findings.title: The 10-test primary suite never executes — pytest cannot import tests.py
top_findings.evidence: tests.py:3 `from fastapi.testclient import TestClient`; .coverage line_bits has NO row for tests.py (only basic_test.py and main.py), and main.py's only executed line is line 1 (`from fastapi import ...`), so the fastapi import raised. requirements.txt:1-3 pins fastapi==0.104.1 / pydantic==2.5.0, whose pydantic-core==2.14.1 has no wheel for this environment's Python and fails its Rust build. scores.json test_coverage=0.06.
top_findings.suggestion: Do not pin 2023-era versions; declare `fastapi` / `pydantic` unpinned (or >=), and verify `python -m pytest tests.py` actually collects before declaring done.

top_findings.title: R12 'at least 3 unit/integration tests' — 10 tests written but none run; the 3 that run assert nothing
top_findings.evidence: tests.py:8-119 declares 10 genuine integration tests (test_health_check, test_create_book, ... test_filter_books_by_author) but .coverage records zero executed lines for tests.py. basic_test.py:11,42,61 are the only functions pytest collected and ran; `grep -c assert basic_test.py` = 0.
top_findings.suggestion: Fix the dependency pins so tests.py runs, and add asserts to basic_test.py (or delete it) so a failure cannot pass.

top_findings.title: basic_test.py's 3 collected tests are assertion-free and all took their except branch — pytest reported 3 green on a broken build
top_findings.evidence: Decoded .coverage line set for basic_test.py is [3,4,5,6,9,11,14,18,19,36,37,38,42,44,45,57,58,59,61,63,65,68,69,70,72] — lines 36-38, 57-59 and 68-70 are the `except Exception` / print('✗ ...') / `return False` bodies of all three functions. Because basic_test.py:11-70 contains no `assert`, returning False is reported by pytest as a pass.
top_findings.suggestion: Replace `try/except -> return False` with plain asserts so an import failure fails the test run.
